## endo sealers 


```{r, message=F, warning=F}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)

# 1. Define your group columns
group_cols <- c("Group.1...ProRoot", "Group.2...Ion.", "Group.3...BC", "Group.4...AH.Plus")

# 2. Reshape into long format and drop NAs (independent structure)
df_long <- endo_sealers %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(group_cols),
    names_to = "Group",
    values_to = "Score"
  ) %>%
  drop_na(Score)

# Clean up group names
df_long$Group <- gsub("Group\\..*?\\.\\.\\.", "", df_long$Group)
df_long$Group <- sub("\\.$", "", df_long$Group)


# --- (1) One-Way Independent ANOVA (ProRoot, Ion, BC) ---
df_3groups <- df_long %>% filter(Group %in% c("ProRoot", "Ion", "BC"))

model_3_indep <- lm(Score ~ Group, data = df_3groups)
print("--- Independent One-Way ANOVA (ProRoot, Ion, BC) ---")
summary(model_3_indep)
anova(model_3_indep)


# --- (2) Two-Sample Independent Pairwise Comparisons (All 4 Groups) ---
# Fit standard linear model without the Error() blocking term
model_all_indep <- lm(Score ~ Group, data = df_long)

# Compute estimated marginal means and run pairwise two-sample t-tests with Tukey adjustment
emms_indep <- emmeans(model_all_indep, ~ Group)
pairwise_indep <- pairs(emms_indep, adjust = "tukey")

print("--- Two-Sample Independent Pairwise Comparisons (Tukey-adjusted) ---")
print(pairwise_indep)

```


* observations marked with * are removed.
